description: This PHP source file defines the AllowedPermission class, which models permission settings with read, create, update, and delete options, including constructor, factory method, and accessors.

classes.name: AllowedPermission
classes.description: A class representing permission settings with boolean flags for read, create, update, and delete permissions. It includes methods for instantiation from an array and getters for each permission.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an AllowedPermission instance with specified boolean flags for read, create, update, and delete permissions.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Factory method to create an AllowedPermission instance from an associative array of permissions.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Returns whether read permission is granted.

methods.name: canCreate
methods.description: Returns whether create permission is granted.

methods.name: canUpdate
methods.description: Returns whether update permission is granted.

methods.name: canDelete
methods.description: Returns whether delete permission is granted.
